scope.flow: Force exercise settlement in RiskEngine.exerciseCost invoking PanopticMath.calculateIOAmounts
scope.environment: Panoptic protocol RiskEngine and PanopticPool with Uniswap V3 pool settlement

statements.text: An existing long option position is being force exercised, which is a closing event terminating that position.
The exerciseCost function invokes PanopticMath.calculateIOAmounts to compute token deltas and required collateral for the force exercise.
exerciseCost passes the _move parameter as true (open/mint context) instead of false (close context) for a closing force exercise.
Using open logic for a close event results in the exercisee being charged or refunded an incorrect amount of underlying assets.
Incorrect IO amounts cause PanopticPool settlement to not perfectly offset liquidity removed from the Uniswap V3 pool, leading to dust accumulation or small protocol losses over time.
If open math requires more collateral than the user has while closing, the force exercise transaction may revert entirely, leaving snipable positions open.
A force exercise, being a closing event, should compute token deltas and collateral using the close (_move=false) context so settlement offsets removed liquidity correctly.

ambiguities: Report does not state who triggers force exercise or any authorization condition.
No concrete numeric expected-versus-actual token amounts are provided.
Whether the incorrect amounts are asserted as observed or only possible is unclear; impacts are phrased as potential.
